figurative_meaning_en: Eager or desperate to get married
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে বিয়ে-পাগলা হয়ে গেছে, সবসময় বিয়ের কথা বলে।
গ্রামের মেয়েটি বিয়ে-পাগলা, বয়স হয়ে গেলেও স্বামী খুঁজছে।
example_sentences_in_english: She has become marriage-crazy, always talking about weddings.
The young man is desperate to get married and can't stop thinking about it.
note: Commonly used in colloquial Bengali to describe intense desire for matrimony, reflecting cultural emphasis on marriage.
